text: all things are become slippery & we cannot hold them behold we are surrounded byDemons yea we are encercled about by the angels of him who hath sought to destroyour souls behold our iniquities are great O Lord canst thou not turn away <​thine angar​> from us &this shall be your language in them days but behold your days of probation is passed ye have procrastinated the day of your Salvation untill it is everlastingly to late & your destructionis made sure yea for ye have sought all the days of your lives for that which ye couldnot obtain & ye have sought for happiness in doing iniquity which thing is conterary tothe nature of that righteousness which is in our great & eternal head O ye People ofthe land that ye would hear my words & I pray that the angar of the Lord be turned awayfrom you & that ye would repent & be saved & now it came to pass that Samuel the Lamanite did prophesy a great many more things which cannot be written & behold he sayeth unto them Behold I give unto you a sign for five years more cometh & behold then cometh the Son of God to redeem all those who shall believe on his name & behold this willI give <​unto you​> for a sign at the time of his comeing for behold there shall be great lights inHeaven insomuch that in the night before he cometh there shall be no darkness insomuch
